domains.name: Spatial Asset Preparation
domains.scope: Prepare controlled spatial asset handoffs and material comparisons with explicit coordinate contracts and observable evidence.

skills.name: procedural-material-parameter-isolation
skills.description: Design a controlled material comparison that isolates a procedural parameter from lighting, geometry, and rendering changes when a material behaves unexpectedly.

skills.name: spatial-coordinate-unit-handoff
skills.description: Prepare a coordinate and unit contract for transferring a spatial asset between tools when scale, orientation, origin, or transform handling may change.
